Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mistakenly concluded that Brooklyn College is part of "The State University of New York (SUNY)" instead of the "City University of New York (CUNY)." This mistake occurred because the Planner misinterpreted the results provided by WebSurfer in Step 6. The WebSurfer had correctly identified and provided multiple authoritative sources (e.g., the official CUNY site and the official Brooklyn College page, as well as Wikipedia) clearly stating Brooklyn College is part of CUNY. Furthermore, the Planner failed to verify this conclusion against the clear evidence and instead introduced an unsubstantiated claim that Brooklyn College is part of SUNY, which directly conflicts with the available data. This error follows the pattern of misidentification of hierarchical affiliations due to incomplete synthesis of available evidence or overgeneralization (as seen in Example 2).
